resources.string: DOOMCOUNT detects navigation changes in the apps you select to estimate short-video transitions. It does not read message contents, capture screenshots, or record audio. You can disable this service at any time in Android Settings.

This prototype investigates whether Android Accessibility events can reliably distinguish short-video feed transitions in TikTok. Raw event counts are shown below — no counts are yet claimed to represent real video swipes.
Privacy: only event type, package name, and timestamp are observed. No video content, messages, or text are captured.

1. Tap "Enable in Settings" below.
2. Find "DOOMCOUNT" in the list.
3. Toggle "Use DOOMCOUNT" on.
4. Return to this screen.
